scope: Nearby candidate projection tiers from represented base terrain height; exact local RA2 instructions, with unknown bridge-origin flag controls explicitly separate.
groundProjection: At a candidate cell, sample up to six cells along(+1,+1). A sampled base level differing by at least2*k-1 at offsetk occludes that candidate. Actual code walks8 leptons at a time; supported base levels0..14 and offsets1..6 are executed.
selection: Accumulate admitted cells in existing ring order, up to24. Stop at the end of a ring when any accumulated candidate projects back to itself, or at cap24. Pick nativeFrame modulo projection-matching subset, falling back to all collected candidates when none matches.
dependencies: Synthetic64x64 map bounds/cells with real base heights, controlled occupation masks, actual infantry occupation marking and coordinate query
Real Tactical projection6a6a50 and original Nearby/cell clearance/Scatter execute; no flat-projection adapter
Locomotor stationary/empty-destination, mission/veteran callbacks and controlled one[0,4] draw; physical walking and whole game initialization are not executed
limits: Source origin flag0x1000 enables adding4 for sampled bridge flag0x100. Those supplied-bit controls prove only conditional code; this project has no demonstrated representation of origin flag0x1000, so no new bridge flag mapping is inferred.
Base-height projection is simulation-derived and does not call rendering. Existing bridge/layer/path admission remains the project model.
